title: Existential selection failure predicate
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, natural numbers $d,c,A,a$, and a Boolean list $y$, the predicate is true exactly when there is some natural number $j$ strictly less than $vwid(A,a,|x|)$, where $x$ is the first component of the decoded pair represented by $y$, for which the selection predicate is false on the level query encoding of $y$ at level $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet
